audit_report.root_cause_claim_text: Cost of sales to revenue ratio for FY2017 is 55.4%
audit_report.rationale: The extractor correctly captured FY2017 revenue ($34,350M) and cost of sales ($19,038M). The analyst calculated 19038/34350 = 55.4%, but this is mathematically incorrect. The correct ratio is 55.4% when calculated as (19038/34350)*100 = 55.39%, which rounds to 55.4%. However, reviewing the three-year average: (32.5 + 55.4 + 53.7)/3 = 47.2% is correct IF the individual ratios are correct. Rechecking: 2018: 20441/36397 = 56.2% (not 32.5%), 2017: 19038/34350 = 55.4% (correct), 2016: 17405/32376 = 53.7% (correct). The FY2018 revenue extraction is wrong (C01 shows 63397 but evidence states 36,397). This caused A01 to calculate an incorrect ratio of 32.5%, which then cascaded to the wrong final average. The root cause is C01's incorrect extraction of FY2018 revenue.
